answer: The reef graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the garden audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 7 times its size, so a group of 5 keys loses far more than 5 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the tide checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
